title: The Kitchen Table
alt: Ethan and Leo study a glowing old map beneath a warm kitchen lamp after the storm.
caption: Under the kitchen lamp, the brothers discover that Grandpa's map is more than an old piece of parchment.

title: First Arguments
alt: Ethan and Leo point to different clues on the map during their first disagreement.
caption: With the mysterious map between them, Ethan's caution clashes with Leo's eagerness for adventure.

title: Grandpa's Journal
alt: Ethan opens Grandpa's weathered journal while Leo peers at its ship and constellation sketches.
caption: Grandpa's journal links ships, stars, and the map to a secret life the brothers never knew.

title: Symbols and Stars
alt: Ethan holds the map toward the window as Leo points to matching constellations in the sky.
caption: The brothers realize that the map's symbols only make sense when matched with the stars.

title: The Decision
alt: Ethan carefully packs the folded map while Leo gives him an encouraging thumbs-up.
caption: Ethan agrees to follow the map, as long as the brothers plan carefully and stay together.

title: Gathering Supplies
alt: Ethan packs rope and a flashlight while Leo adds snacks to their backpacks in the attic.
caption: Morning preparation combines Ethan's practical planning with Leo's cheerful adventurous spirit.

title: The Boat
alt: The brothers proudly inspect their patched blue rowboat in the golden sunset.
caption: After careful repairs, Grandpa's forgotten rowboat is ready to carry them toward the unknown.

title: The Farewell
alt: Backpacks on, Ethan looks back at the warm house while Leo guides him toward the moonlit boat.
caption: The brothers leave the safety of home behind and step into the clear, star-filled night.

title: Setting Out
alt: Leo rows their patched boat into the golden dawn while Ethan checks the map and supplies.
caption: With the shore fading behind them, Ethan and Leo begin their journey across the open water.
